name: You Know We Kinda Suck, Right?
source:
Fritz and Dinah kinda suck. 

As a duo, as witches, and, sometimes they think, as people. 

But right now isn't a time to think about that, not when they need magic tears from Selene in the sky yesterday! And nothing is going to stop that not even... a trip through memory lane on Fritz's end that was triggered from said magic tears due to the tears coming from something, or rather someone, sentient? Who seems to think her boredom might be alleviated from witnessing Fritz and Dinah's frustrating relationship and... helping? In her own way???

That might distract from their goal. Just a little.

[From [url=https://bibixp.itch.io/you-know-we-kinda-suck-right]itch.io[/url]]
